component-o.description-s: JST GH side-entry SMT header, 1x5, 1.25 mm pitch, tin, 1.0 A per contact (AWG 26), 50 V, -25~85 C. LED sub-board link: pins 1-4 one LED drive (anode) each, pin 5 the common return (cathode, ground). Mates with GHR-05V-S / SSHL-002T-P0.2.

connector-o.contact_resistance_source-s: JST GH catalog p1: Contact resistance: Initial value 30 mOhm max; after environmental tests 50 mOhm max
connector-o.board_area_note_s: courtyard plus the on-board part of the mate keepout (right-angle at the board edge: the mate overhangs the edge)

mate-o.frame_s: the board connector's footprint frame; the model is built there, so offset and rotation are zero
mate-o.source_s: JST GH catalog: GHR-05V-S housing B 7.50 x 4.15 x 5.7 mm (p2 table); side-entry header 4.25 high; mated housing overhangs the board edge, so the board gives only the courtyard; insertion depth estimated as for SM14B-GHS-TB
